def simplify(x, n):
    def extract_fraction(fraction):
        numerator, denominator = map(int, fraction.split('/'))
        return numerator, denominator

    def is_whole_number(num, den):
        return num % den == 0

    x_num, x_den = extract_fraction(x)
    n_num, n_den = extract_fraction(n)

    product_num = x_num * n_num
    product_den = x_den * n_den

    is_whole = is_whole_number(product_num, product_den)

    return is_whole
